summary: End-to-end UI validation of the Event Gallery per-photo assignment + lightbox + studio order/ZIP/PDF/link-regen flow. Logged in studio1@test.com/Test1234 via /studyo, created a fresh event (date 2026-06-15), added a service pack (Ahşap Tablo · 150₺ · limit 3), uploaded 3 JPGs (Dsc002635/6/7). VERIFIED: (a) each studio thumbnail shows its filename code label; sg-download-zip returns a valid ZIP whose entries preserve original filenames ['Dsc002635.jpg','Dsc002636.jpg','Dsc002637.jpg']; per-photo sg-photo-orig-* links exist. (b) On /galeri/{share_token}, all 3 photos rendered with gs-code-* labels; clicking gs-open-lightbox-<pid> opens gs-lightbox showing gs-lightbox-code=filename; gs-lightbox-next/prev cycle photos (Dsc002635→Dsc002636→back to Dsc002635); gs-lightbox-close closes; per-photo gs-lb-album/canvas/retouch toggles work; gs-lb-pack-<packId> assigns pack. (c) gs-assigned-summary correctly shows 'Ekstra Albüm · 2 × 500₺ = 1000₺ · Dsc002635.jpg, Dsc002636.jpg' after assigning the same pack to two photos. (d) gs-submit → gs-success shown with order number. (e) In /studyo/galeri Siparişler tab, the created order returns album_codes=['Dsc002635.jpg'], canvas_codes=['Dsc002636.jpg'], retouch_codes=['Dsc002635.jpg'] and pack_details with kind='Diğer' (note below), qty=2, total=1000, codes=['Dsc002635.jpg','Dsc002636.jpg']; sg-order-codes-<id> renders all groups. (f) sg-order-pdf-<id> downloads a PDF (2.2KB, valid). (g) sg-extend-<id> 'Link Yenile' is repeatedly clickable (2 successive clicks both succeed and button remains). Cleaned up the test event.

rca of the issue: Bug 1 (minor): kind mismatch — In gallery.py public_select or the pack serializer, kind field likely defaults instead of being copied from the ServicePack record when building pack_details. Reproduce: create a pack with kind='Ahşap Tablo', assign to a photo via client lightbox, submit; GET /api/studio/gallery/orders returns pack_details[0].kind == 'Diğer'. Mitigation: ensure kind is copied from the source pack document in the pack_details construction.
